```yaml
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.1'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Read current version
        id: read_version
        run: |
          if [[ ! -f _includes/VERSION.txt ]]; then
            echo "VERSION_FILE_NOT_FOUND=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            VERSION=$(cat _includes/VERSION.txt)
            if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
              echo "INVALID_VERSION_FORMAT=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            else
              echo "CURRENT_VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
              echo "NEXT_VERSION=$((VERSION + 1))" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            fi
          fi

      - name: Check for missing version file
        if: env.VERSION_FILE_NOT_FOUND == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Error: _includes/VERSION.txt not found"
          exit 1

      - name: Check for invalid version format
        if: env.INVALID_VERSION_FORMAT == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Error: Invalid version format in _includes/VERSION.txt"
          exit 1

      - name: Validate tag doesn't exist
        id: check_tag
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="v${{ env.NEXT_VERSION }}"
          if git rev-parse "$TAG_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "TAG_EXISTS=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "TAG_EXISTS=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Fail if tag already exists
        if: env.TAG_EXISTS == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Error: Tag v${{ env.NEXT_VERSION }} already exists"
          exit 1

      - name: Update version file
        run: |
          echo "${{ env.NEXT_VERSION }}" > _includes/VERSION.txt

      - name: Commit version update
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "chore: bump version to ${{ env.NEXT_VERSION }}"
          file_pattern: _includes/VERSION.txt
          tagging_message: "v${{ env.NEXT_VERSION }}"

      - name: Build Jekyll site
        run: |
          bundle install
          bundle exec jekyll build

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          folder: _site
          clean: true
          commit-message: "Deploy site for version ${{ env.NEXT_VERSION }}"
```
